other_conditions: Enterprises must be 100% owned by SC/ST persons
Legal forms allowed: sole proprietorship, partnership, company
Both new enterprises and expansion of existing enterprises are eligible
Eligible sectors: manufacturing and services, including trading projects above the UYEGP threshold
Beneficiaries may also claim other capital subsidies from non‑Tamil Nadu schemes
Training will be provided by the Entrepreneurship Development and Innovation Institute
benefits_summary: Provides a 35% capital subsidy (up to ₹1.5 Crore) and a 6% interest subvention on loans.
